{{Short description|Finnish racing driver (born 1979)}} {{Infobox F1 driver | name = Kimi Räikkönen | image = Kimi Räikkönen 2021.jpg | nationality = {{flagicon|FIN}} [[Finland|Finnish]] | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1979|10|17|df=yes}} | birth_place = [[Espoo]], [[Finland]] | Championships = 1 ([[2007 Formula One World Championship|2007]]) | Wins = 21<ref name="stats">{{cite web|url=https://example.org|title=Stats}}</ref> | Poles = 18 | First race = [[2001 Australian Grand Prix]] | Last race = [[2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix]] }} '''Kimi-Matias Räikkönen''' (born 17 October 1979) is a Finnish former [[racing driver]] who competed in [[Formula One]] from 2001 to 2021.<ref>Ref text</ref> He won the [[2007 Formula One World Championship|2007 World Drivers' Championship]] with [[Scuderia Ferrari|Ferrari]].
== Early life == Räikkönen was born in Espoo.
[[Category:Finnish Formula One drivers]]

{{Infobox Grand Prix race report | Type = F1 | Country = Monaco | Grand_Prix = Monaco | Race_No = 5 | Season_No = 22 | Date = {{Start date|2021|05|23}} | Official name = Formula 1 Grand Prix de Monaco 2021 | Location = [[Circuit de Monaco]], [[Monte Carlo]], Monaco | Course = Street circuit | Course_km = 3.337 | Distance_laps = 78 | Distance_km = 260.286 | Weather = Sunny {{nowrap|Air: {{convert|23|C|F}}}} | Attendance = 7,500<ref>{{cite news |title=Crowd |url=https://example.org}}</ref> }} The '''2021 Monaco Grand Prix''' (officially known as the ''Formula 1 Grand Prix de Monaco 2021'') was a [[Formula One]] motor race held on 23 May 2021 at the [[Circuit de Monaco]].

{{Infobox F1 team | Name = McLaren | Base = [[McLaren Technology Centre|Woking]], [[Surrey]], England | Founders = [[Bruce McLaren]] | Principal = {{nowrap|[[Andrea Stella]]}} | Engines = [[Mercedes-Benz in Formula One|Mercedes]] | First entry = [[1966 Monaco Grand Prix]] | Cons_champ = 10<!-- update after each season --> | Drivers' Championships = 12 }} '''McLaren Racing Limited''' is a British motor racing team based at the [[McLaren Technology Centre]] in [[Woking]], [[Surrey]], England.
